payload.title: named personas and generic positions
payload.body: Operator ruling: named agents (mav, nico, kino) are main-session personas, each with its own specialty and personality, elevated above the generic position they hold; generic agents (architect, planner, implementer, assayer) are geared to subagent task work. mav stays a distinct persona over the architect role; the generic architect stays as the subagent-oriented holder of that role.
